variants.title: Coupled spring oscillators on an air track: undamped
variants.sample: Two generic 200 g gliders, three springs
variants.method: Periods of the two normal modes
variants.note: On the air cushion friction is negligible: the modes ring for minutes.

source.title: Generic apparatus: the value is a setting of this bench, not a property of a named material

variants.title: Coupled spring oscillators on an air track: damped
variants.sample: Two generic 200 g gliders with damping magnets
variants.method: Mode periods, then the decay of the in-phase mode
variants.unknown: the damping coefficient and the coupling coefficient
variants.note: Magnets on the gliders induce eddy currents in the aluminium track: the amplitude falls as exp(−γ t).
